_howto: Country ISO-3166 alpha-2 code -> Adsterra zone identifiers, resolved SERVER-SIDE from the visitor's country of origin. Only the three HIGHEST-CPM formats are ever served: native banner (key), social bar / in-page push (script URL) and popunder (script URL). Every country inherits DEFAULT and overrides only the keys it sets, so you can start earning immediately and add per-GEO zones as you create them in the Adsterra dashboard. To target, say, US traffic with a dedicated US native zone: create 'Native_US' in Adsterra, then add "US": { "nativeBanner": "<new-key>" } under zones below. Anything you don't override keeps the DEFAULT global zone.
